# Apify

> > Apify is a web scraping and automation platform for building, deploying, and integrating Actors—serverless cloud programs for data extraction, AI agents, and API integrations.

Apify provides a marketplace of ready-made Actors for scraping popular platforms like LinkedIn, Google Places, Reddit, and Temu, along with SDKs in Python and JavaScript. The platform supports AI agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), MCP integrations, and developer tools including CLI and ApifyClient for building custom automation workflows.

## Key Topics

- Actors (serverless cloud programs)
- Web scraping and data extraction
- API integration
- Python and JavaScript SDKs
- ApifyClient
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- AI agents (LangChain, LlamaIndex)
- LinkedIn scraping
- Google Places and Maps APIs
- Automation and batch processing
- Developer tools and CLI
- Actor builds and memory allocation
- HTTP and cURL integration
- Social media scraping (Twitter, Reddit, YouTube)

## Platform APIs and Integrations

- [LinkedIn search API](https://apify.com/api/linkedin-search-api): LinkedIn search API for profiles, jobs, companies, and email validation
- [Google Places API](https://apify.com/api/google-places-api): Google Places API for business data: names, addresses, ratings, hours
- [Temu API](https://apify.com/api/temu-api): Temu API for product data: prices, ratings, reviews, sales counts

## Python Client Documentation

- [Reddit API Python Client](https://apify.com/api/reddit-api/python): Python client for Reddit API: posts, comments, votes, user data extraction
- [job scraping API Python Client](https://apify.com/api/job-scraping-api/python): Python client for job scraping API with LinkedIn integration examples
- [Google Vision API Python Client](https://apify.com/api/google-vision-api/python): Python client for Google Vision API image scraping and data extraction
